properties.label: Eight-plate specimen gallery
properties.text: Arrange eight compact specimen plates as a disciplined 4-by-2 gallery over one wide processed chromatic field; each plate contains an index, compact palette, family name and one contextual note.

properties.label: Compact neutral specimen labels
properties.text: Keep every plate's index, family name and note compact, neutral and readable over the field.

properties.label: Shared violet-ochre chroma field
properties.text: Use one luminous field spanning violet, ochre, pink and blue behind dark translucent plates; keep swatches crisp and opaque rather than giving every card an independent gradient.

properties.label: Two-scale pixel texture
properties.text: Combine coarse field pixels with finer grain to create two inspectable scales of detail.

properties.label: Quiet readable gallery
properties.text: Keep the background quiet and the plates fixed for reading; on mobile reflow to two columns without losing a specimen.

properties.label: Historical membership qualifier
properties.text: Do not present historical family memberships as current totals.

properties.label: Field-through-plate acceptance
properties.text: Ensure the color field remains perceptible through the plates while every label stays readable.
